# William H. Downs, CPA

William H. Downs, CPA is a solo accountant in Sherman Oaks, California.
The office is at 13701 Riverside Drive, Suite 400, Sherman Oaks, CA 91423.
Phone: (818) 981-4313. Email: wdownscpa@earthlink.net.
Work: income tax preparation, estate tax returns on Form 706, and trust taxes.
Work: fiduciary income tax returns, fiduciary accounting, and probate accounting.
Clients are individuals, families, trusts, estates, and other accountants.
The office sits at Riverside Drive and Woodman Avenue in the San Fernando Valley.
Bill Downs started the practice in 1971 and studied accounting at UCLA.
To reach the office, call (818) 981-4313 or email wdownscpa@earthlink.net.
